Step title: Grit and Growth: Tools for Academic Resilience
rationale: This step supports the development of perseverance and grit, which are essential skills for academic success. By engaging students in activities that challenge them to persist through difficulties, this step helps cultivate the mindset and behaviors necessary for long-term achievement. Fostering these qualities aligns with broader educational objectives of preparing students to become self-directed, resilient learners capable of navigating academic and life challenges.
Content Outline:
- Develop a growth mindset to overcome academic challenges
- Practice self-regulation and goal-setting for sustained effort
- Seek support and feedback to build resilience and perseverance
- Embrace mistakes as opportunities for learning and improvement
- Cultivate a positive, determined attitude towards academic success
